title: Alberta grid emergency, January 13 2024
timezone: America/Edmonton (MST, UTC-7). AESO hours are 'hour ending'; hour_start is the start of that hour.

aeso_hourly.what: AESO Actual/Forecast report: hourly pool price ($/MWh) and Alberta Internal Load (MW)

aeso_smp.what: AESO Historical System Marginal Price report ($/MWh), every price change

eccc_hourly.what: Environment and Climate Change Canada historical hourly data, CALGARY INTL A (station 50430), LST

timeline.text: AESO declares a Grid Alert (EEA3), step 16 of 22 in its supply-shortfall procedure.
timeline.source: AESO newsroom, Jan 13 2024; Power Advisory, 'January 2024 Supply Shortfall in Alberta'

timeline.text: Emergency text alert to every phone in Alberta: high risk of rotating outages, cut use to essentials.
Demand drops 100 MW immediately, ~200 MW within minutes.
